clauses.clause: Sole operative paragraph: returns for the chapter 41 tax (interest equalization tax) shall be open to inspection by certain classes of persons and State and Federal establishments under Treasury Decision 6543 as amended
Effectiveness sentence: the order is effective upon filing for publication in the Federal Register

propositions.claim: EO 11206 was printed in the Federal Register of March 23, 1965, at page 3741, under its title.
propositions.quote: Tuesday, March 23, 1965 FEDERAL REGISTER 3741 Executive Order 11206 INSPECTION OF INTEREST EQUALIZATION TAX RETURNS

propositions.claim: The order's one command opens chapter 41 tax returns to inspection by certain classes of persons and government establishments.
propositions.quote: it is hereby ordered that returns made in respect of the tax imposed by chapter 41 of such Code shall be open to inspec­tion by certain classes of persons

propositions.claim: The order took effect on filing for publication; it was filed on March 22, 1965.
propositions.quote: This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the F ederal R egister

propositions.claim: EO 12553 of February 25, 1986, revokes the listed executive orders and any amendments to them.
propositions.quote: it is hereby ordered that the following Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked

propositions.claim: EO 11206 is on the EO 12553 revocation list by number and subject.
propositions.quote: 11206 Providing for inspection of interest equalization tax returns

propositions.claim: The current 26 U.S.C. 6103 note lists EO 11206 among orders revoked by a later executive order (quoted from the evidence slice; the note itself was not opened in this run).
propositions.quote: Executive Orders 10738, 10906, 10954, 10962, 11102, 11206, 11213, 11650, and 11706, listed above, were revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 1

review.conclusion_reason: The express named revocation establishes operative NO and formal revoked status before the cutoff. EO 12553 dates the revocation February 25, 1986, and contains no separate effective-date provision. Its whole-order revocation covers the inspection authorization and effectiveness provision; the latter had already triggered on filing in 1965.

verdicts.reason: Held official-printing OCR identifies March 23, 1965, page 3741, EO 11206 and the stated title.
Held text commands that chapter 41 returns shall be open to inspection by specified persons and State and Federal government establishments, subject to Treasury Decision 6543 and its amendments.
Held text contains the quoted effectiveness sentence; its filing annotation reads 'Filed, Mar. 22, 1965; 11:05 a.m.'
Held EO 12553, page 7237, dated February 25, 1986, expressly states that the listed Executive Orders 'and any amendments thereto, are revoked'.
Held EO 12553, page 7240, expressly lists '11206 Providing for inspection of interest equalization tax returns'.

Independently opened the public Code note at https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/6103, Executive Documents, Inspection of Tax Returns. It confirms the quoted list including 11206 and completes the truncated reference: '12553, Feb. 25, 1986, 51 F.R. 7237.'
